summary: Nottingham City Airport is a regional general aviation airfield located at Tollerton, approximately 6 km southeast of Nottingham city centre. Built on the former RAF Tollerton site from the Second World War era, it serves as a base for private flights, charter operations, flight training, and business aviation, offering a quieter alternative to the larger East Midlands Airport.
